in_marathi.name: Atharvashiras
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Knowledge of the gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Atharvashiras हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Atharvashiras is a name derived from the ancient Indian text, the Atharvaveda. It is believed to represent the god of the same name, who is considered the guardian of knowledge and wisdom. The name is often used to bestow the blessings of knowledge and enlightenment upon a child.
